infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 105 in the two-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 105 key (Dorm 105) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the two-story dormitory with a tag reading "105" on it.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The first floor of the two-story dorms on Customs in the fenced-off section that must be entered from outside the first floor north door.
